channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Facing criticism, Harvard health center will focus on pediatrics, not Israel
item.description: A Harvard University think tank will shift its focus following extensive criticism that it focused too much on anti-Israel programming.

item.title: DEI staffer plans to sue UCLA after being fired for celebrating Charlie Kirk murder
item.description: Johnathan Perkins, a former UCLA DEI director, plans to sue the university for firing him over social media posts celebrating Charlie Kirk's assassination.

item.title: Up to 25 percent of U.S. colleges may close soon, Brandeis president warns
item.description: Higher education is approaching a period of profound disruption, and many colleges may not survive, Arthur Levine, the newly appointed president of Brandeis University, said during a recent event. Levine estimated that between 20 and 25 percent of colleges will close in the coming years, while community colleges and regional universities move increasingly online. He […]

item.title: Judge rules against Ohio State U. for expelling student over anti-Israel TikToks
item.description: A federal judge ruled against Ohio State University this month after the school expelled a student for posting anti-Israel videos on social media that administrators claimed encouraged violence. The judge granted a preliminary injunction, directing the school to delete from the former student’s academic record any mention of his expulsion, according to court documents. Speech […]

item.title: Yale activists strike out on oil, Israel, and weapons divestment
item.description: Divestment activists proposed a slew of companies and industries they opposed. Yale's investment advisory committee reject them all.

item.title: Washington bill would require universities to provide abortion pills
item.description: Washington state lawmakers are considering legislation to require that public colleges and universities offer abortion pills on campus and provide referrals if they lack health centers.

item.title: ‘Trans’ scholar begins dissertation with ‘Hello, darling,’ then tells publisher to remove it
item.description: Anilenia Hernández's dissertation, “A Brief History of My Gendered Body,” was removed from ProQuest at the author's request after facing backlash online.

item.title: Inside SEEK 2026: Is Catholic faith thriving on college campuses?
item.description: The College Fix’s Gabrielle Temaat went to the 2026 SEEK conference to witness one of the biggest gatherings of Catholic and Christian students since Charlie Kirk’s assassination. She asked students what it’s like to live out their Catholic faith on secular college campuses.

item.title: ‘Abortion care’ still covered by Catholic Loyola University Chicago
item.description: The Catholic Church opposes abortion - but yet Loyola University Chicago helps students kill their babies.

item.title: Michigan State U. to pay $300K to professor called ‘racist’ by trustees
item.description: A professor raised concerns about the ethics of a board chair. That led to him being tarred as a racist.
